graft.title: stop.edits-unrecorded still blocks after the session's journal entries were proposed and accepted (propose trust)
graft.need: The fix for graft:01a15bae (count journal entries as recording) doesn't cover a session at `propose` trust. In vg-dotfiles this session edited nix/flake.nix, nix/nixos/flake.nix, nix/nixos-wsl/flake.nix (owned by vg-dotfiles / Composition) and home/modules/git/default.nix (vg-dotfiles / Home / git), then filed proposal 01a15d78-d91e..e400 with a decision journal entry on Composition and a misstep entry on Home / git. The user accepted it. The stop guard still says "recorded nothing" for those four files, both while the proposal was pending and after it was accepted, at two stops in a row. It should count a filed proposal of this session (pending or accepted) whose changes touch the owning node or an ancestor as recording.
graft.use_case: Agents at propose trust record through proposals as the conduct asks; today every stop after a recorded change blocks until the session ends, so the guard trains agents to ignore it.

answer.text: Fixed in tend e4f1f35, deployed. The guard matched a proposal to the session by origin.session only, and an MCP server names the harness's session only when it found that session's start record (else its own id, as yours did: 01a15c24-02d8…). Now a proposal this agent filed in this checkout since the session began counts as recording, pending or accepted. A test covers it (another agent's, or one from another checkout, doesn't count). Restart the session to pick up the new tend for its hooks.
